ignoreCommand: [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && exit 1; git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --unshallow origin 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --depth=2000 origin main 2>/dev/null; git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . 2>/dev/null; [ $? -eq 0 ]
